title: Helen Haines: Father of suspect in Australian MP attack says politician was long-time family friend - BBC
description: Helen Haines remains in a critical but stable condition and has reportedly lost a leg. The suspect has been named in local media as an environmental campaigner.

title: Alberta voters reject a move toward independence in referendum backing Canadian unity - NPR
description: Voters in Canada's oil-rich Alberta province overwhelmingly backed remaining in Canada, with early referendum results Tuesday delivering a boost to Prime Minister Carney's push for national unity.
